text:
Predicates:
GivenOut(x, y) ::: Roses are given out on TV show x at time y.
Bachelor(x) ::: x is on the TV show The Bachelor.
Portrays(x, y) ::: x portrays the lives of real people in y.
RealityTV(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
Premises:
∃x (Monday(x) ∧ Time(x, 8pm) ∧ GivenOut(roses, x)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (GivenOut(x, y) → Bachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (Bachelor(x) → Portrays(x, realPeople)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (Portrays(x, realPeople) → RealityTV(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTV(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
GivenOut(roses, breakingBad) → (Monday(breakingBad) ∧ Time(breakingBad, 8pm)) ::: If roses are given out during Breaking Bad, then it is on Monday at 8 pm.
